name: Compressors and air pumps
summary: Pumps that move or compress gas: fridge and AC compressors, air compressors, tyre inflators and small air pumps.
uses: Running air tools and filling tyres
Spare compressor for a fridge or freezer (needs refrigeration skills)
Vacuum or air supply for projects
identify: Fridge and freezer compressors are black domes low at the back with copper pipes; AC units hold bigger ones outside. Air compressors have a tank and a pump; 12V tyre inflators live in car boots; aquarium air pumps are small buzzing boxes.
test: Air pumps: run them and feel for flow at the outlet. A fridge compressor’s three pins should read a few ohms between each pair and open to the case. Don’t cut charged refrigerant lines, and don’t trust a rusty air tank: it can burst.

decay.note: Lasts. Sealed fridge compressors keep their oil and gas for years.
